## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `b84b2cf721023e29e303079587a9aa9cf1c01955`
Local-runs: none

Face: declaration (`check-owed-reviews`: no published schema, no governed path, no narrowing). Read: card #32984 with every comment (rulings 6929121584, 6929142905), the PR body and comments (L1-b 6930100435, body delta 6930159459), the 18-file net diff against merge-base `6a7403ba`, and the head's check-runs. No earlier contract record on this PR.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`@object-ui/i18n` key set: widened, right.** One new namespace, `chatbot.build.health`, with four count families (`sampleRowsLive`, `views`, `widgets`, `seeds`) and `verified`. No key is removed or renamed in any pack. All eleven locale files carry the same five base keys.
- **Plural slots: right.** Each pack carries exactly the suffix set its own `chatbot.build.needsAttention` family already carries: ar `zero/one/two/few/many/other`; ru `one/few/many/other`; es, fr, pt-BR `one/many/other`; de, en `one/other`; ja, ko, zh-Hans, zh-Hant `one/other` (the `_one` slot is unused by those languages and harmless). The ru forms agree in case and number, including the `_other` fraction form. ar uses the "label: count" shape in every slot, as its `needsAttention` does.
- **Placeholders: right.** Every count string holds the `count` placeholder and nothing else; every `verified` holds the `checks` placeholder. No English is left in a non-en pack ("widget" in es, fr, pt-BR, de is the loanword those packs use).
- **`PublishHealthLine`: right.** Five literal keys at the call sites, `count` passed for the four families, English `defaultValue` for a provider-less host. `seedError` and `issues[].message` render as before, which keeps Q1 (6929121584) free of this diff. `publishHealth.ts` is untouched.
- **`useChangeCardLabels`: right for what it declares.** Published registry by name first (`readObjectsByName`, unchanged), then one `?preview=draft` read per object name; a missing label falls back to the name through `useObjectLabel`, a failed or empty read (the client answers `null` on 404) is kept as none, and nothing throws. The resolver identities change when an answer lands, so the card redraws. The hook is imported only by `AiChatPage.tsx`, so it adds no published surface.
- **English wording.** "seed" becomes "sample data set"; the pin in `ChatbotEnhanced.test.tsx` moves with it.
- **Tests: not tautological.** The four hook cases pin the overlay call (`withPreviewDrafts(true)`, `get('object', name)`, once) with two controls (no draft read for a published object; an unknown name asked once). The four pack cases render through `I18nProvider` and assert the composed line in zh-Hans, ru (one, few, many in one line) and en, plus a control that an error withholds the verified claim and passes producer text through.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` stand line-initial in the PR body and the changeset, and agree with the claim (6927733897). Right: nothing an author can write changes.
- `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/i18n` is the level AGENTS.md sets for kind `none` (Post-Task Checklist step 3), and matches PR #33333 on this same card (new pack keys, widening, patch). `2b267b78` declared one added pack key as `no`; `yes` is the stricter reading and costs only this review.
- The changeset names every package the diff moves. Its sentences agree with the code ("once per object while the chat is open", "A published object still answers from the registry without a draft read", "no key is removed or renamed").

### ③ Boundary flags

- S1 (should-fix) — the "Edge, Q2's territory" note understates the edge. `changeCardLabels.ts` `findDraft` keeps the first overlay answer per object for the pane's life, and the pane is keyed by conversation. So after a change adds a field (or creates an object) in the same conversation, EVERY later card naming that field or object shows the machine name, not only "that card". Add a field, then adjust it, is the flow the change card exists for, and acceptance 5 is the line this PR delivers. Q2 is ruled "nothing is built now" (6929142905, parameter 1), so it does not cover this today. Required: either re-ask the overlay when the kept answer lacks the asked field or is none (bounded, for example once per card or after a change applies), with a pin; or state the true extent in the note and name its carrier, as the "Order of the two worlds" note now does (6930159459).
- "Order of the two worlds": answered by body delta 6930159459 (stays open on #32984 item 5, card comment 6930132262). Accepted as a named carrier.
- "Browser look: NOT MEASURED": stated with a checkable reason. Not re-measured here.
- "Left as is (Q1's line)": the `seedError` English fallback belongs to Q1's console PR. Agreed.
- Scope: every file is inside claim 6927733897's file surface. `MetadataProvider.tsx` and `publishHealth.ts`, both allowed, are untouched. No scope creep.
- SQL push-down: no server code in the diff. The overlay read is one GET per unknown object name; no id materialisation, no in-app join.
- Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.
- Check-runs on this head when read: 28 success, 15 skipped, 18 in progress (Test UI shards 1 to 16, Type Check UI, a re-run of Check Changeset), none red. Landing waits for all of them green, the ui i18n key gates among them.
- N1 (nit) — `findDraft` starts its request during render. The `asked` ref keeps it to one request, so behaviour is right; an effect would be the conventional place (also L1-b's note).

Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5mjfxPu5HKjUtuveBR`

**结论：REWORK（1 项）**

本轮只读了 delta，共 2 个提交、4 个文件：`changeCardLabels.ts`、`AiChatPage.tsx`、hook 测试和 changeset。

**已核对、没有问题的部分**

- hook 的逻辑：
  - 记下的答案里有卡片要的对象或字段时，就不再请求。
  - 没有时，同一个 `revision` 内最多请求一次；正在请求中不重复发；渲染不会引发请求。
  - 跨 revision 时，旧请求结束后还会补问一次，这是有界的。
  - `setDrafts` 只在 promise 回调里调用，渲染期间不会改 state。
- 新增的 4 条 hook 断言：两条是"后来加的字段或对象"，两条是对照组（有界补问、记下的答案不重复请求）。正文写了先红读数：只含 pin 的提交上 8 个用例红 3 个，当前 head 转绿。
- changeset 改动的那一句（"at most once per object per message or turn"）与代码一致。
- 不采纳 N1 的理由（子组件在自己渲染时调用 resolver）我读了，成立。

**R1 · 调用处的 revision 没有任何测试钉住**

这次修复在用户可见层面能生效，靠的是 `AiChatPage.tsx` 里传给 hook 的第三个参数：`` `${shownMessages.length}:${isLoading ? 'turn' : 'idle'}` ``。新增的断言全部在 hook 层面，并且都自己调用 `rerender({ rev })`。如果把调用处的参数改成常量（例如 `0`），8 条 hook 断言全部照样是绿的，但 S1 描述的现象会原样回来：同一会话里后面那张卡片仍然显示机器名。也就是说，本轮的修复在页面这一层没有被消融覆盖到。

二选一：
- (a) 加一条 ChatPane 层的断言。可以沿用 `AiChatPage.*.test.tsx` 现有的测试装置：第一张卡出现后，草稿 overlay 才有了某个字段；会话再往前走一条消息后，后一张卡显示的是 label。正文里要写出这条断言在调用处改成常量时会变红（先红或消融读数）。
- (b) 如果页面层确实做不到，就在正文 Acceptance notes 里写明调用处的 revision 没有钉住，并给出可以核对的理由，说明为什么这一层无法测。

**CI**：这个 head 的 CI 还在跑，我这次没有读。上一个 head 的红都来自被后续推送取消的分片，与本次 diff 无关。R1 修完后我只读 delta，并会等所有 Test UI 分片跑完再给结论。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `6cc3b3c91222192a933de4df81458cc0e451d558`
Local-runs: none

Face: declaration. Delta round over the record 6930210370 (PASS at `b84b2cf721023e29e303079587a9aa9cf1c01955`), answering delta comments 6930564017 and 6931433293. An earlier round at `d4a5a19c944cebf0c3f32ba674e98d12b8bd9fbb` was written but not posted (the head moved); this record carries its judgment. Read: `git diff b84b2cf7..6cc3b3c9` (the `d4a5a19c` code delta: `changeCardLabels.ts`, `AiChatPage.tsx`, the hook's test, the changeset; then `d4a5a19c..6cc3b3c9`: two test files only), the PR body at this head, and the head's check-runs. Everything the earlier record judged outside these files is unchanged and stands.

### ① Derived judgments

- **S1 (should-fix): closed.**

  `useChangeCardLabels` takes a `revision`, and `findDraft` re-reads the overlay only when the kept answer does not name what is asked (no object, or not that field), the object was last asked at another revision, and no read for it is in flight.
  - Bounded: `ChatPane` passes the message count plus turn/idle (`AiChatPage.tsx`). Neither moves on a render or on a streamed token, so a render never refetches. A name that stays unknown costs at most one GET per revision move, per object; a name the kept answer holds costs none.
  - No race: `inFlight` allows one read per object at a time. An answer that lands after the revision moved is kept, and the next resolver call asks again if it still misses.
  - Hook pins (`changeCardLabels.drafted-32984.test.tsx`): a field added later, an object created later, five renders at one revision make one read and the next revision exactly one more, and a kept answer holding the field is not re-read. Not tautological: on `b84b2cf7` the `asked` set answers each name once for the pane's life.
  - Call-site pin (new, `AiChatPage.appliedCardDoors-12894.test.tsx`, answering 6930605580): the real `ChatPane` with `ChatbotEnhanced` as a recorder that resolves a field in its render. The overlay gains `discount` only after the first card read `discount`; one message is appended; the card must read `折扣`. Not tautological: with a fixed revision at the call site, `askedAt` equals the revision on the second pass, `findDraft` makes no second read, and the text stays `discount`. The double clones its answer (`structuredClone`), so the pass cannot come from the test mutating the kept object, and the wrapped client is cached per real client, so the pass does not come from a new `client` identity. The body reports the ablation (revision replaced by a constant, pin red); that is the lane's run, not re-run here.
- **Hook signature: right.** The third parameter is required; the only caller is `AiChatPage.tsx`, and the hook is not exported from the package entry. No published surface moves.
- **Census row: right.** See M1 below.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged: `patch` on the same three packages, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. `d4a5a19c..6cc3b3c9` touches no shipped file and not the changeset.
- The changeset sentence is true to the code: the answer is kept per object and re-asked when it lacks the asked name, once the conversation moved.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **M1 (must-fix): closed.**

  `openPathObjectReaders-12811.test.ts` `OBJECTS_READERS` now names `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/changeCardLabels.ts`, kind `byName`, with its reason; the `AiChatPage.tsx` row is gone. Both sides of the census agree with the tree at this head: `changeCardLabels.ts` calls `readObjectsByName` (the census's by-name spelling, and the `byName` case's required substring), and `AiChatPage.tsx` holds no `readObjectsByName` call and no `.objects` read off its `useMetadata()` binding, so the census does not find it.
